title: Vehicle Service Contracts Held per Borrower and per Vehicle
content:
**Rule.** A Vehicle Service Contract covers one financed vehicle: a borrower may hold one on each financed vehicle, without a per-borrower limit, but a vehicle never has more than the plan's number of service contracts in force at once on one financed vehicle.

**The same rule, split by the object it counts**

| What is counted | Limit |
|---|---|
| Service contracts held by one borrower across all of the borrower's financed vehicles | No per-borrower limit (none is set) |
| Service contracts in force at once on one financed vehicle | The plan's per-vehicle number of service contracts in force at once |

The unit of the limit is the vehicle, not the borrower: what matters is which financed vehicle a Vehicle Service Contract covers.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical borrowers)**

- A borrower with two financed vehicles, each under its own retail installment contract, may hold a Vehicle Service Contract on each of them; holding two is not limited by any per-borrower count.
- A borrower with three financed vehicles may hold three Vehicle Service Contracts, one per vehicle, for the same reason.
- Whatever the number of vehicles, each single vehicle never has more service contracts in force than the per-vehicle number.
